title: JSON exception when receving historical values from 600SeriesAndroidUploder
symptom: Using Medtronic 640G pump and 600SeriesAndroidUploader as collecting app, in latest release only current value appears in Xdrip, history values do not appear. Log shows 'Got JSON exception org.json.JSONException: No value for direction'.
cause: Changes made on 4/7 in NSEmulatorReceiver.java in function bgReadingInsertFromData added a slope parameter, reading it from direction parameter in JSON, which does not comply with 600SeriesAndroidUploader.
fix: Update to the Sept 29th nightly, which resolves the problem.
evidence_quote: Further code review show - changes were done on 4/7 at file at file: app/src/main/java/com/eveningoutpost/dexdrip/NSEmulatorReceiver.java in function: bgReadingInsertFromData slope parameter was added, reading it from direction parameter in JSON
